post.summary: Draw the partners and send every participant an email with their partner
post.description: Nobody draws themselves or an excluded partner, including the partners of imported draws, and no two participants draw each other. The draw is stored even if some emails could not be sent, they have no `notifiedAt` and can be sent again. The drawn partners are never returned.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

get.summary: Get the partners the participants of a list must not draw
get.description: Only the exclusions set by hand are returned, exclusions imported from draws are never returned.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

404.description: List not found or not accessible by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

put.summary: Set the partners a participant must not draw
put.description: Replaces the participants the participant must not draw. If `mutual` is set, the changes are applied in the other direction as well: newly excluded participants must not draw this participant, and participants that are no longer excluded may draw this participant again. Exclusions between other participants are left unchanged.

receiverIds.description: The ids of the participants this participant must not draw

mutual.description: Apply the changes in the other direction as well

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Exclusions changed, all exclusions of the list are returned

400.description: A receiver is not a participant of the list or the participant themselves, or the list is archived

404.description: List or participant not found or the list is not accessible by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

post.summary: Import the partners of the latest draw of a list as exclusions
post.description: Nobody draws the partner they drew in the latest draw of the source list, which can be the list itself. Participants of both lists are matched by their Nextcloud account or their email address. The imported exclusions are only used for drawing, they are never returned as they would reveal the partners. Importing again adds the partners of participants added in the meantime.

sourceListId.description: The id of the list whose latest draw is imported

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Exclusions imported, the list is returned

400.description: The partners of the source list have not been drawn yet or the list is archived

404.description: List or source list not found or not accessible by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in
